brief_summary: Every lunar year, during the month of Ramadan, Muslims abstain from food and drink between dawn and nightfall. People with type 2 diabetes who fast during Ramadan are at an increased risk of acute glycemic complications. Our aim is to investigate the effect of dosage reduction of four glucose-lowering multidrug regimens on the incidence of acute glycemic complications in people with type 2 diabetes who fast during Ramadan.
